propositions: _blame_file_commits currently returns [] both on git failure and on successful-but-empty blame, making failure indistinguishable from empty result and preventing abort-on-failure logic
derive_caused_by tallies per-path blame results; partial path failures cause strict-majority test to run over a subset and elect a wrong culprit that would not win over the full set
blobless clone promisor faults blobs one at a time during git blame over historical trees on every bug close without explicit --caused-by, creating conditions for partial failure
_blame_file_commits must return None on git failure and [] on successful-but-empty result so derive_caused_by can distinguish and abort only on true failures
clone guidance doc must record measured numbers (full 1.04 GiB / 59 s vs blobless 68.7 MiB / 14.3 s) and prohibit --filter=tree:0 (3.57 GiB measured)
legitimate empty-result files must not abort derivation, while partial git failures must prevent persisting an incorrect caused_by link
